limits_of_claim: Not a high-availability  demonstration: An interruption of ~20 seconds was observed.
No crash-consistency proof: The Pod was deleted gracefully via API, not abruptly terminated during in-flight write operations.
Not a backup test: The original data remained completely intact on the same persistent volume.
Node-bound limitation: The persistent volume  may be tied to a single node. A full node failure remains untested and could prevent recovery.
